svg.title: Tarang FM — Live AI radio station · Indian-language voice AI
svg.desc: Feature 2 of 8: Tarang FM — Live AI radio station · Indian-language voice AI. Status: built for the Sarvam Bulbul Build Challenge, where it won first place. A live radio station in five Indian languages, where every voice is AI. RJs, news from 160+ feeds, spoof ads and a radio serial, each line acted by a Sarvam Bulbul V4 Flash voice. Hold to talk, or phone the studio, and the RJ answers you on air. Fig. 5, how a show airs: 1. Write — Sarvam-105B writes the script; code checks and a producer judge pass it; 2. Voice — one of 33 Bulbul V4 Flash voices acts each line; 3. Air — one shared live show per station, on Durable Objects. Stack: TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Workers KV, Bulbul V4 Flash, Saaras v4. Link: tarang-fm.dualmindlab.tech.
